When did the army actually arrive? How many soldiers remained? Did supply and missing strength recover? What was actually paid along the way? Before comparing, every replay must begin at the same verified starting point.

packaging.text_en: Plan C takes a different route, through verified waypoints to London. In this independent replay, on game day 77 after the shared start, we first observed the main army in London. It was still en route on day 75. It arrived between those observations. The exact moment is unknown. This main army started with 6,679 soldiers. Supply capacity remained 300. Current attrition at the endpoint was 1%. That was the rate under current conditions. It does not tell us how many died en route. These figures describe the original main army. They are not the total soldiers in all player units.

packaging.text_zh: 接着看两个不同的窗口。起点后的第二十六到二十七日，主军人数净增七，新分队净增三，两端库存相同。第三十一到三十二日，主军补给从约一百零六点一四升到一百二十六点一四，新分队两端都是一百，完整兵团的人数与编制也没变。人数净变化与补给增加各记自己的日期，不能剪成同一次结算。后来两军回到同地实际合军，合前补给约一百二十六点一四和一百。按双方各自的合军权重加权、分别取整，得到约一百一十三点零六。合后容量读到一百，库存实际也是一百。这个窗口能单独确认上限截断，不能用两队库存的普通平均代替。
packaging.text_en: Next, consider two separate observation windows. Between days 26 and 27, the main army gained seven soldiers net; the new group gained three. Supply was unchanged at both endpoints. Between days 31 and 32, main-army supply rose from about 106.14 to 126.14. The new group had 100 at both endpoints. The full regiment roster and soldier counts were also unchanged. Record soldier changes and supply gains on their own dates. Do not edit them into a single update. Later, the two armies reunited at the same location and actually merged. Before merging, their supply was about 126.14 and 100. Apply each army's merge weight and round down each contribution. The result is about 113.06. After merging, capacity was 100, and actual supply was also 100. This window independently confirms the upper-cap clamp. A simple average of the two supply stocks cannot replace that calculation.

packaging.text_zh: 结果表按同日期或同事件对齐：先看实际抵达，再看完整兵团与可用人数，然后是库存、补员和损耗窗口，最后是实际支付。这次B合军后，原二十七个兵团仍在，但又多出一条满员一人的兵团记录；合后共有六千六百九十人，满员六千七百四十八。实际统帅也变了，与原先冻结的条件不符。新增记录和统帅变化的原因还没有确认。因此，这次B在第三十八日停止，尚有五十二日预算；停止是冻结条件未通过，不是时间耗尽。这段能保留为合军机制样本，却没有可比较的伦敦终点。C也出现多次采样偏差：原计划每次最多过一天，实际跨了两天。后续只保留为描述性观察，即使已经到达，也不能恢复成严格公平的A/C对照。A和C的实际到达观测各自保留。下面回到整军直走的A。
packaging.text_en: Align results by the same date or event. First check actual arrival, then the full regiments and available soldiers. Then check supply, reinforcement and attrition windows, and finally actual payments. After B's merge, all 27 original regiments remained. But a new regiment record appeared, with one soldier out of a maximum of one. The merged army had 6,690 soldiers, out of a maximum of 6,748. The commander also changed, breaking the conditions fixed at the start. The causes of the new record and commander change remain unconfirmed. So B stopped on day 38, with 52 days left in its budget. It stopped because the fixed conditions failed, not because time ran out. We can retain this as a sample of the merge mechanism. But it has no comparable London endpoint. C also had multiple sampling deviations. Pulses planned for at most one day actually advanced two. The later results are retained as descriptive observations only. Reaching London does not restore a strictly controlled A/C comparison. The actual arrival observations for A and C are retained separately. Now we return to A: the whole army taking the direct route.

packaging.text_zh: 本期已经分别观察到补给回满、实际补兵、不同窗口的兵员减少，以及同日分合军的库存和组织变化。后续休整也出现了真正的库存与人数增加。整军直走和换路线各自保留了真实到达观测；分兵方案因冻结条件变化停止，换路线回放又保留采样偏差，因此没有严格三方案的胜负结论。真实饥饿和逐笔付款仍等待各自证据。你可以按这个顺序读自己的军队，再让每条新结论有自己的日期、身份和结果。
packaging.text_en: We observed full supply, actual reinforcement, and soldier decreases in separate windows. We also observed supply and roster changes during same-day splits and merges. Later rest periods produced actual increases in supply and soldier counts. The whole-army direct route and the alternate route each retain an actual arrival observation. The split-army plan stopped after its fixed conditions changed. The alternate-route replay retains sampling deviations. So there is no strictly controlled three-plan verdict. Actual starvation and itemized payments still need their own evidence. You can read your own army in this order. Give every new conclusion its own date, identity and observed result.
